sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items:
Added a new "Recording of " column (label includes MusicBrainz's own empty, CSS-styled work-glyph icon, matching the convention it's always shown with) to `release-tracks`, extracted from the "ARs" relationship data's `
recording of:
Work Name...
` block (see e.g. `/release/6d19588c-0305-4fb0-b687-d4b75a75c3fd`'s DVD-Video medium) — keeps the work link, same as every other entity reference extracted this session. Also adds one column per recording attribute actually used somewhere on the release (`Acappella`, `Cover`, `Demo`, `Instrumental`, `Karaoke`, `Live`, `Medley`, `Partial` — MusicBrainz prefixes the `
` with these, e.g. `"live cover recording of:"`), showing the attribute name itself when present (e.g. "live") and an empty cell when absent. Both gated by the existing page-wide "only render when at least one track has a value" pattern, plus a new master setting `sa_enable_release_tracks_recording_of_columns` (default **on**) for the whole feature. Positioned directly before "ARs" (not chained after Title like every other column added this session), attribute columns first, then "Recording of", then "Recording date" (see below).

Unlike every prior extraction this session, this one is purely additive: the work link is *cloned*, and the "ARs" column's underlying `div.ars` content is never touched, removed, or modified — "ARs" keeps showing the exact same full relationship data (work link included, now duplicated) it always has. Per explicit instruction, since the source `dl.ars`'s `<dd>` also holds nested writer/lyricist/publisher `dl.ars` blocks that have no column of their own and must not be lost.

Fixed the "Recording of" column's work-glyph icon not actually appearing in the rendered header — the column's `<th>` is later completely rebuilt from a plain text string by the standard sort/filter header pipeline, which destroys any child element appended to it beforehand. The glyph is now injected afterward instead, mirroring the same established pattern already used for the CAA/EAA column-header thumbnail toggle button. A second issue then surfaced: the glyph element existed in the DOM but stayed invisible, because any direct child of a flex container (`.mb-col-hdr-flex`) has its `display` forced to a block type by the CSS spec regardless of its own `display` value, which strips the line-height-derived height an inline icon normally gets from its native, non-flex context — a childless block box with no explicit height is just 0px tall. Fixed by giving the injected glyph an explicit height. A third issue then surfaced: a trailing space text node after the glyph (added so it wouldn't sit flush against the sort icons) turned out not to survive CSS whitespace-collapsing between two flex-blockified siblings — replaced with an explicit `margin-right` on the glyph itself, which isn't subject to that collapsing.

Added a new "Recording date" column to `release-tracks`, positioned directly after "Recording of", extracting the optional `(on YYYY-MM-DD)` date MusicBrainz appends after the work link in the same "recording of" `<dd>` (e.g. "(on 1978-07-07)" → "1978-07-07") — same purely-additive/page-wide-gated pattern as "Recording of" itself, under the same `sa_enable_release_tracks_recording_of_columns` master setting.

Reordered the whole "Recording of"/"Recording date"/attribute-column group: the attribute columns (`Acappella`/`Cover`/…/`Partial`) now come first, followed by "Recording of", then "Recording date", then "ARs" — previously "Recording of" and (then-named) "Date" preceded the attribute columns. Renamed "Date" to "Recording date" at the same time, since a bare "Date" read ambiguously next to the release-level tracklist.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: `release-tracks`' "Disambiguation" column no longer keeps the literal `(`/`)` MusicBrainz wraps the comment's text in (e.g. "(version 1)" → "version 1", "(live, 1978‐07‐07: …)" → "live, 1978‐07‐07: …") — redundant once the comment has its own dedicated column. New `_stripSurroundingParens()` helper strips a leading `(`/trailing `)` from the cell's first/last actual text node via a `TreeWalker`, handling both structural shapes the comment can appear in (bare text directly in `span.comment`, or wrapped in a nested `<bdi>`).
`release-tracks`' `integerColumns` now also center-aligns (`align: 'C'`) the native `#` track-number column, matching `Rating`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed the overflow-tracklist progress bar (WIP.9) only ever showing its static initial "medium 1 of 1..." text with no fill, instead of live progress. It was previously only updated once a medium fully finished loading — for the common case of a single overflowing medium (often the release's ONLY one), that meant the bar showed nothing but the initial text for the entire load (which can itself take as long as a whole paginated fetch), then flashed a completed state for a moment before the next phase's progress bar overwrote it. Now updates live as each medium's own AJAX response streams rows in, reusing the same `MutationObserver` that already detects completion — fill percentage, track count, and the remaining-time estimate all progress continuously during a medium's own load, not just between mediums.

Fixed the same progress bar's label text getting clipped on both ends (e.g. "Loading" losing its "Load") — its container's `min-width` (420px) was sized for the original, shorter paginated-fetch label and never grows to fit longer content since its fill/label children are both `position:absolute` and so don't contribute to the container's own auto width. Bumped to 600px, comfortably fitting the overflow-tracks label's worst case (~73 characters) while staying under the existing 750px cap.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: `release-tracks`' "Disambiguation" column is no longer unconditional — it's now only created once at least one track on the release has the parenthetical comment, same page-wide decision as "Video"/"Recording artist" (`renderGroupedTable()`'s shared header template forces this to be decided once across the whole release, not per medium). "AcoustIDs"/"ISRCs" deliberately keep their current behavior (created whenever their setting is on, independent of whether data is present yet) — their data arrives via an async third-party lookup that's often still in progress when this script runs, which is exactly why the late-arrival `MutationObserver` (added earlier this session) exists; gating their column creation on data already being present would make that observer's job impossible most of the time, since it has nowhere to place data once its destination column doesn't exist.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a progress indicator for `release-tracks`' "Load all tracks..." overflow handling (`loadAllOverflowMediumTracks`), reusing the same inline progress bar the paginated-fetch loop already shows ("Loading page X of Y... (Z rows) - Ns left"). On a release with several overflowing mediums (each its own AJAX round trip that can take a few seconds), this phase previously ran silently before the real fetch loop even started, which could look like a hang. Now shows "Loading overflow tracks: medium X of Y... (Z tracks) - Ns left", updated once per medium (not continuously during each medium's own wait).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items:
Added a new "Recording artist" column to `release-tracks`, extracted from the native `
Recording artist: …joined artist links…
` MusicBrainz glomms into the Title cell when a track's recording is credited to a different artist than the release itself (e.g. a live cover, a guest performance — see e.g. the "2 - DVD-Video" medium on `/release/6d19588c-0305-4fb0-b687-d4b75a75c3fd`). The whole `` — preserving every joined artist link and join phrase verbatim, same reasoning as the release-level Artist backfill — is moved (not cloned) into the new column. Like "Video", the column's presence is decided once, page-wide (any track on the release has the credit), not per medium, since `renderGroupedTable()`'s single shared header template would otherwise silently drop a `` present on only some mediums' native theads. Positioned directly after "Artist" — the release-level credit reads first, with the recording's own (possibly different) credit immediately beside it.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Renamed `release-tracks`' (WIP.4) "AcoustID"/"ISRC" columns to "AcoustIDs"/"ISRCs" (plural, since each cell can hold more than one entry).

Added a new, conditionally-created "Video" column to `release-tracks`, extracted from the native `<span class="video" title="This recording is a video">` icon MusicBrainz glomms into the Title cell for video recordings (see e.g. the "2 - DVD-Video" medium on `/release/6d19588c-0305-4fb0-b687-d4b75a75c3fd`) — reuses the existing, generic `ColumnDataExtractor.video` extractor (already used by several other pageTypes, e.g. `artist-recordings`, via a normal `columnExtractors` entry) rather than duplicating its move-the-span/audio-video-sort-key logic. Unlike a normal `columnExtractors` entry, which always creates its synthetic column, the "Video" `<th>` is only added when at least one track ANYWHERE ON THE RELEASE (any medium) has the icon, so a release with no video tracks at all never gets a permanently empty column — decided once, page-wide, not per medium: `renderGroupedTable()` builds a single header `<thead>` template from the first `table.tbl` in the document and clones it for every medium, so a `<th>` present on only some mediums' native theads would silently vanish from every rendered table (row data still carries through per group, the header does not). Positioned directly after "Title" (before "Disambiguation").

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a new (default on) `sa_enable_release_tracks_acoustid_isrc_observer` setting: a `MutationObserver`-based reactive fix for the "AcoustID"/"ISRC" columns (WIP.4) so late-arriving data from a third-party userscript's async AcoustID lookup (e.g. jesus2099's, a network round-trip to acoustid.org per recording — routinely still in progress by the time this script's own one-shot extraction pass ran) reaches those columns instead of being silently missed. Watches each medium's table for AcoustID/ISRC data appearing after the fact and relocates it into the right column reactively, mirroring the existing area-flag/region-correction observer (`initAreaFlagRegionObserver`). Only does anything when at least one of the AcoustID/ISRC column settings is on; zero overhead otherwise. Required switching `applyExtractTrackTitleData()`'s Title-cell cleanup from cloning the recording link/ARs/AcoustID/ISRC content to *moving* it — a clone would silently break this fix, since whatever the decorating userscript is tracking (a live object reference, or a re-query matching the same class/attributes) needs the actual live node to still be present in the rendered table for its own late decoration to land anywhere this observer can see it.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed the "ARs"/"AcoustID"/"ISRC" columns (WIP.4) never getting a collapse toggle on any release-tracks page with more than one medium, even when a cell's content clearly overflowed the clamp. Root cause: `renderGroupedTable()`'s `shouldStayOpen` heuristic (which decides whether a sub-table starts expanded or `display:none`) only recognizes a lone sub-table or the literal categories `album`/`official` — release-tracks' medium-title categories ("1 - CD", "2 - DVD-Video", …) matched neither, so every medium on a multi-medium release started hidden. `initCollapsableColumns()`/`makeColumnsResizable()` then ran immediately afterward against that still-hidden table — measuring `scrollHeight`/`clientHeight` on a `display:none` element always reads 0 in a real browser, so the overflow check permanently found nothing to add a toggle to, even after the section was later expanded by hand. This bug predates this session but was invisible until `collapsableColumns` was added to release-tracks in WIP.4. Fixed by keeping every release-tracks sub-table expanded by default regardless of medium count — matching the feature's whole point (consolidating a release's tracklists into one always-visible view) and avoiding the hidden-at-measurement-time trap entirely.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: `release-tracks`' "Title" column no longer shows the raw glommed cell MusicBrainz (and, once it has run, the third-party jesus2099 "SUPER MIND CONTROL" script) builds it from — just the clean track title now. Everything else that used to be crammed into that cell is extracted into its own new column: a "Disambiguation" column (the parenthetical comment shown when a track's title differs from its recording, e.g. "(live, 1978‐07‐07: The Roxy Theatre, West Hollywood, CA, USA)"); an always-present, collapsible "ARs" column at the end of the table (the recording's general relationships — engineer, producer, recording-of-work, publisher, … — previously glommed into the Title cell as a `<div class="ars">`), with its own independent collapse-height settings (`sa_enable_ars_collapse`, `sa_ars_column_max_height_em`, `sa_ars_column_max_width`) rather than sharing the "Annotation" column's; and two new off-by-default multi-row columns, "AcoustID" and "ISRC" (`sa_enable_release_tracks_acoustid_column` / `sa_enable_release_tracks_isrc_column`), each entry rendered as its own list row instead of one long comma-separated line — AcoustID entries keep their native ×/+ link/unlink action link. The secondary "recording name" line MusicBrainz shows under a track's title when it differs from the underlying recording's name is dropped (not kept in any column, per explicit confirmation). Implemented via a new `applyExtractTrackTitleData()` DOM-surgery pass (mirroring the existing Artist-column backfill's approach) rather than the additive `columnExtractors` mechanism, since cleaning the Title cell in place isn't something that mechanism supports.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed `release-tracks`' backfilled "Artist" column (WIP.1) truncating a multi-artist release credit down to just the first artist — e.g. a release credited to "Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band" rendered as just "Bruce Springsteen" in every row. `applyNormalizeMediumTracklists()` was capturing and cloning only the first `<a href="/artist/...">` found inside `p.subheader`'s `<bdi>`, dropping the join text (" & ", ", ", " feat. ", …) and any subsequent artist links; it now captures and clones the entire `<bdi>` artist-credit element, matching how MusicBrainz's own native Various-Artists per-track Artist cells already render multi-artist credits.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed `release-tracks`' "Load all tracks..." overflow handling (WIP.1) resolving after only a few milliseconds and still rendering the truncated 100-row tracklist: MusicBrainz replaces the triggering `<tr>` with a loading placeholder almost instantly on click, long before the AJAX response with the real rows has arrived, so waiting for that `<tr>` to leave the DOM (the original signal) fired a false-positive completion. `loadAllOverflowMediumTracks()` now parses the expected final track count from the overflow message ("...out of 1209 total.") and waits for the `<tbody>`'s actual data-row count to reach it, falling back to an idle-mutation heuristic only when that count can't be parsed; the per-medium timeout was also raised from 15s to 30s to give large tracklists room to load.

Fixed jesus2099 "SUPER MIND CONTROL" hover-toolzone artifacts (Merge/Edit/Open-edits quick-action `<div>`s, e.g. `<div class="jesus2099userjs81127toolzone" style="display:block">`) being cloned into the final rendered Length column with a baked-in `display:block` from whatever hover state was active at scrape time. Added a new generic `'jesus2099-any'` `columnErasers` sentinel (removes any element whose class starts with "jesus2099userjs", by prefix rather than one hardcoded suffix, since that userscript embeds an install/version-specific numeric ID) alongside the existing exact-class `'jesus2099'` sentinel, and applied it to `release-tracks`' Length column.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a new `release-tracks` pageType for bare release pages (musicbrainz.org/release/<mbid>), consolidating every medium's native tracklist into the standard filterable/sortable multi-table view via a new "Show all Tracks for Release" button (gated by the new `sa_enable_release_tracks` setting, default on). Each medium's `<thead>`-embedded title (e.g. "1 - CD") is synthesized into a sibling `<h3>` so the existing release-group h3-sibling-walk grouping pipeline can be reused unmodified; the native `<tr class="subh">` header row is promoted into a proper `<thead>`; an `Artist` column is always present, backfilled with the release's main artist credit on non-Various-Artists releases. Mediums truncated by MusicBrainz's own "Load all tracks..." overflow link (>100 tracks) are auto-loaded and awaited before the tracklist is scraped, so no tracks are missed. The native "Edit recording comments" button and settings-icon are stripped from the reused `h2.tracklist` header once it becomes the global filter/master-toggle anchor. Also adds a new additive `features.removeSelectors` (plural array) post-render step alongside the existing singular `removeSelector`.
